components.name: CardDeal
components.description: CardDeal (07a) — investment deal card, 1:1 modernization of the legacy Safqah deal card, composed only from prior Data Display components: StatusPill (status) + Tag (exclusive tag & ROI), inline media/text. Layout (Hero·Row) × State (Available·Reserved·Invested·Closed) × Direction (LTR·RTL). Line-arrow nav icon (Back3). Swap media image per deal. Fully tokenized.

components.name: CardDeal / Metric
components.description: Metric molecule — SemiBold label + Regular value. Standards-based, tokenized, LTR/RTL.

components.name: CardDeal / Headline
components.description: CardDeal Headline atom — title text. Direction LTR/RTL. Title is a text property.

components.name: CardDeal / Highlights
components.description: CardDeal Highlights atom — feature line. Text prop, LTR/RTL, Regular 11 muted.

components.name: CardDeal / Media
components.description: CardDeal Media atom — image surface. Size=Hero (16:9, r16) / Thumb (square, r8). Swap the image fill per deal.

components.name: Goal / Headline
components.description: Goal Headline atom — title text, LTR/RTL.

components.name: Goal / Illustration
components.description: Goal illustration placeholder — abstract network/map motif. Swap with real KSA-map art per use.

components.name: Goal / Summary
components.description: Goal Summary atom — lg RadialProgress + label + total amount. LTR/RTL. Total is a text prop.

components.name: Goal / PhaseRow
components.description: Goal PhaseRow molecule — RadialProgress + percent + title + amount(riyal icon) + chevron. Percent (+100%/100%/50%/0%) × Direction. Green for met (+100/100), gray for pending (50/0).

components.name: Goal / Amount
components.description: Goal Amount atom — number + riyal icon. Size (sm/md/lg) × Tone (Default/Inverse/Brand). Value text prop. Reused by PhaseRow (sm) and Summary (lg).

components.name: GoalActivate
components.description: GoalActivate (CTA) organism — pre-activation. Illustration + Headline + body + Button. Phase (Begining/Started/Static) × Direction.

components.name: GoalTracker
components.description: GoalTracker (active) organism — header + PhaseRow list + Summary. State (Overachieved/Complete/Active/Early) × Direction = 8.

components.name: CardAction / Label
components.description: CardAction Label atom — title + optional info. Size sm (tile/row) / md (prompt) × Direction. Title/Info text props + Show info boolean.

components.name: ActionTile
components.description: ActionTile — quick-action tile. Size (Small/Default) × Style (Vertical/Horizontal) × State (Default/Selected/Disabled) × Direction. Arrow icon, icon swap, Label.

components.name: ActionPrompt
components.description: ActionPrompt — larger CTA/prompt card. Icon badge + Label(title+description) + Button. Tone (Neutral/Brand/Warning/Success) × Direction. Icon swap.

components.name: CardInfo / Content
components.description: CardInfo Content atom — title (SemiBold 13) + description (Regular 13), text/brand/darkest, LTR/RTL.

props.name: Title
props.default: Need any help with your investments?

components.name: CardInfo
components.description: CardInfo — informational/guidance card. Type (Icon / Avatar) × Tone (Brand/Info/Success/Warning/Error/Neutral) × Direction = 24. Circular badge + title/description + chevron; tone-themed border/badge/icon/text. Matches workspace refs (Brand Icon/Avatar) + extends with semantic tones.

components.name: Content
components.description: Content — the shared list/row text block (Material anatomy): Overline + Title + Supporting (description). Size (Bold/Medium) × Direction. Composed by ListItem, SelectRow, and all List styles.

components.name: ListItem
components.description: ListItem — universal list row. State (Default/Hover/Pressed/Selected/Disabled) × Direction. Slots via booleans: Has leading (icon swap) / label (Tag) / value / action (Button) / toggle (Switch) / chevron / divider; description via nested Content. Title size Bold/Medium via Content.

components.name: ActionList
components.description: ActionList — grouped list container. Composes ListItem (07e): a card holding stacked rows with dividers (last off), optional section header + footer. Style (Grouped card / Plain) × Direction; Has header / Has footer.

components.name: List
components.description: List — content list display styles (researched from M3 / Apple HIG / Carbon / Polaris): Plain · Divided · Inset (grouped card) · Bulleted (unordered) · Numbered (ordered) · Description (key-value). × Direction. Composes the Content atom. (Selection lives in SelectionList; interactive rows in ActionList/ListItem.)

components.name: List / TextItem
components.description: List / TextItem — a list text row: optional Marker (Bullet / Number) + Content. Composes the Content atom; Number is editable. Used by List Plain/Bulleted/Numbered styles.

components.name: List / DescriptionRow
components.description: List / DescriptionRow — a key-value row: Term + Value. Emphasis (Default / Total = SemiBold term + brand value). Used by the List Description style.

components.name: SelectRow
components.description: SelectRow — a selectable row (selection control + title + description). Type (Radio/Checkbox) × State (Unselected/Selected/Disabled) × Direction. Selected = brand border + tint + checked control. Composes Radio/Checkbox Indicator + ListItem/Content.

components.name: SelectionList
components.description: SelectionList — single/multi-select list. Mode (Single=radio, one choice / Multi=checkbox, many) × Direction; group header + footer. Composes SelectRow (selectable rows with brand-tinted selected state).

components.name: Section
components.description: Section — section header that labels a region: Title + optional Description + trailing Action (See all + chevron) + optional leading icon + divider. Size (Lg/Md/Sm) × Direction. From legacy Headling.

components.name: AccordionItem
components.description: AccordionItem — collapsible disclosure row: header (optional leading icon + Content title + chevron) over a body. State (Collapsed = chevron-down, body hidden / Expanded = chevron-up, body shown) × Direction. Composes Content; body is editable.

props.name: Body
props.default: Open an account, verify your identity, fund your wallet, and choose a plan - it takes about 5 minutes.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Accordion — grouped collapsible disclosure (FAQ/expansion). Composes AccordionItem with dividers (last off). Style (Boxed card / Plain) × Direction. Typically one item open at a time (single) or several (multi).

components.name: PageIndicator
components.description: PageIndicator — carousel page-control. Style (Dots = pill-active · Bars = segmented) × Active (1–5). Active = bg/brand/primary; inactive = border/default.

components.name: Carousel / Slide
components.description: Carousel / Slide — Size (Sm/Md/Lg) × Type (Standard card: media + Content / Hero: full-bleed dark + white Content overlay) × Direction. Composes the Content atom; media/bg swappable.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: Carousel — peek slide strip + PageIndicator. Type (Cards = Standard slides / Hero = full-bleed) × Size (Sm/Md/Lg, Hero=Lg) × Direction. Composes Carousel/Slide + PageIndicator.

components.name: Table / Cell
components.description: Table / Cell — a table cell. Type (Text · Numeric · Avatar · Tag · Status · Select) × Density (Default/Compact) × Direction. Transparent (surface set by the row/table). Reuses Avatar/Tag/StatusPill/Checkbox. Numeric end-aligns; Select centers.

components.name: Table / HeaderCell
components.description: Table / HeaderCell — column header. Sort (None / Asc = chevron-up / Desc = chevron-down, brand) × Density × Direction; optional select-all checkbox. Label editable. Pairs with Table / Cell.

components.name: Table / ActionCell
components.description: Table / ActionCell — overflow (⋯) IconButton + optional inline IconButtons (ghost). Density × Direction; end-aligned.

components.name: Table / Toolbar
components.description: Table / Toolbar — above the table. Mode Default (Search + Filter + Sort) / Selection (N selected + Clear + bulk Export/Delete) × Direction. Reuses Search Input + Button + Checkbox.

components.name: Table / ActionCell
components.description: Table / ActionCell — overflow (⋯) IconButton + optional inline IconButtons (ghost). Density × Direction; end-aligned.

components.name: NewsCard / Developer Logo
components.description: Developer / issuer logo slot used by NewsCard / Poster Caption. 32×16, single-colour glyphs bound to icon/inverse so it sits on imagery. Swap for another issuer logo via the Logo instance-swap on the caption.

components.name: NewsCard / Poster Media
components.description: Full-bleed media for NewsCard / Poster. Image fill (CROP) + soft-light white ramp (Alpha/White/80), a frosted fade (Alpha/White/80, bg blur Shadow/Blur/LG), an overlay scrim (ramp Alpha/Black/10→30→50→70→Shade/Black, drop shadow Shadow/Blur/SM + OffsetY/MD + Alpha/Black/30) and a progressive background blur (radius bound to font/line-height/48 ≈ 72px, ramp Alpha/Black/30→10→50→70→Shade/Black). Image: progressive layer blur Shadow/Blur/LG + inner glow Alpha/White/10 · Shadow/Blur/MD. Chrome: radius/lg, border/subtle. Only fully transparent stops, stroke widths and the 264×463 size stay raw (no tokens exist). Replace the image via the Image layer fill.

components.name: NewsCard / Poster Caption
components.description: Text block that sits over NewsCard / Poster Media: optional issuer Logo (instance swap), Title (heading/18/semibold) and Description (caption/11/regular), all text/inverse. Direction RTL/LTR flips alignment. Padding space/xl (20) vertical, space/2xl (24) horizontal; gap space/xs.

props.name: Description
props.default: هي خاصية متوفرة في أغلب البنوك ,تتيح لك إنشاء أمر تحويل مستمر بشكل شهري يساعدك على المحافظة على خطتك الإدخارية

components.name: NewsCard / Poster Actions
components.description: Footer row of NewsCard / Poster: an IconButton (tertiary · sm, radius/full override, arrow-diagonal-up-left in RTL / up-right in LTR) at the end side and an IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor) at the start side, space-between. Both nested instances are exposed. Status colours come from the badge variant: On plan = Confirmed (green), In progress = Funded (purple), Active = Active (blue), Late = Late (orange), Defaulted = Defaulted (red); edit the label per update. Padding space/2xl sides + bottom.

components.name: NewsCard / Poster
components.description: Poster-style NewsCard (portrait 280×479) for deal / project updates shown in a horizontal carousel. Composes NewsCard / Poster Media (progressive-blur photo) + Caption (logo, title, description) + Actions (IconButton + IssuanceStatusBadge) with a dealTags ClosedWhite "last updated" tab in the top end corner (tab radii radius/lg on the outer corners). Direction RTL/LTR mirrors everything. Surface: Color/Alpha/White/80 + border/default, radius/xl, padding space/sm. Caption, Actions and Tag are exposed nested instances.

components.name: NewsCard / Poster Carousel
components.description: Horizontal peek carousel of NewsCard / Poster cards (mobile content width 358). The Strip hugs 4 posters with gap space/lg (16) and is clipped by the carousel; RTL anchors the strip to the right (first poster rightmost, next peeks on the left), LTR anchors left. Swipe target = one poster + gap. No page indicator by design; add PageIndicator (07j) if the feed has fixed length.
